county.title: County
county.description: Filter to one Texas county (e.g. HARRIS, DALLAS, TRAVIS). Leave empty for statewide.

operationType.title: Operation type
operationType.description: e.g. 'Licensed Center', 'Licensed Child-Care Home', 'Listed Family Home'. Leave empty for all.

minHighDeficiencies.title: Min high-severity deficiencies
minHighDeficiencies.description: Only return operations with at least this many high-severity deficiencies (compliance screening).

maxRecords.title: Max records
maxRecords.description: Cap total records (leave empty for the full registry, ~100k).
